no-land-for-peace.reason: Land-for-peace compromises have often been worthwhile.

property-serves-common-good.reason: Property has social obligations but also individual justification.

soviet-state-capitalist.reason: A contested historical characterization I'd rather not settle.

precautionary-principle.reason: Sensible in grave cases, costly if applied rigidly.

annexed-territory-occupation.reason: Annexation without consent violates international law.

subordinate-church-to-state.reason: Government control of religion threatens freedom.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.reason: A unifying non-partisan figure is useful.

force-to-prevent-secession.reason: Force against secession is rarely legitimate.

sacred-ruler.reason: Rulers should be accountable, not sacred.

character-from-environment.reason: Environment shapes character a lot, though not exclusively.

sovereign-above-law.reason: Rule of law should bind rulers.

equal-parenting.reason: Presumption is debatable; child's best interest first.

land-redistribution.reason: Forced transfer raises property rights concerns.

refugee-return.reason: Return rights are an important principle.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.reason: Ethnic claims beyond borders fuel conflict.

apostasy-punishable.reason: Punishing religious exit violates freedom of conscience.

kin-peoples-union.reason: Ethnic union is not a good basis for states.

rights-where-you-live.reason: Depends on circumstances; both are legitimate.

material-conditions-drive-history.reason: Economic factors matter but not solely.

no-bailouts.reason: Bailouts can be warranted to prevent systemic damage.

gender-parity-bodies.reason: Parity goals are fine; mandates are debatable.

trade-labor-env-standards.reason: Binding standards can prevent a race to the bottom.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.reason: Hereditary rank is hard to justify.

history-own-civilization.reason: Local focus is fine if balanced.

patriotic-education.reason: Schools should teach critical thinking more than patriotism.

end-racial-preferences.reason: Contested; I'm torn on efficacy and fairness.

public-money-creation.reason: Private banks creating money isn't clearly bad.

elective-rulers.reason: Elected heads of state are legitimate; monarchies tolerable ceremonially.
